channel.title: VAELURE EDITION — Private Bureau & Curated Collective
channel.description: An independent private bureau and curated collective featuring ultra-scarce historical echoes and master-tier contemporary corpuses, including works associated with master artist Hesham Malik.

item.title: Curatorial Notes // Dispatch I: The Geometry of Rarity
item.description: Why true masterworks reject the open market and enforce uncompromising, ultra-restricted numeric allocations.

item.title: Curatorial Notes // Dispatch II: Beyond the Gaze
item.description: The subversion of eroticism, power, and survival in master-tier composition from Ter Brugghen to Klimt.

item.title: Curatorial Notes // Dispatch III: The Witness and the Mirror
item.description: Psychological autopsy and unvarnished truth in the works of Francisco de Goya and Vincent van Gogh.

item.title: Curated Masterwork Registry & Private Collection
